description: This PHP class defines a PostgreSQL-specific Data Abstraction Layer for maintenance statistics in the Revive Adserver project, including methods for data migration, deduplication, and rejection of invalid conversions.

classes.name: OX_Dal_Maintenance_Statistics_Pgsql
classes.description: A PostgreSQL-specific Data Abstraction Layer class for maintenance statistics, providing data migration, deduplication, and validation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timestamp cast string and calling parent constructor.

methods.name: _getMigrateRawDataSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for migrating raw data into bucket-based format, using PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT clause.

methods.name: deduplicateConversions
methods.description: De-duplicates conversions with associated unique variables within a specified date range.

methods.name: rejectEmptyVarConversions
methods.description: Rejects conversions with empty required variables within a specified date range.
